items.question: How big is USelf Labs?
items.answer: USelf Labs is run by one engineer, and deliberately takes on few projects at a time to keep engineering quality high.

items.question: Does USelf Labs take on short-term projects?
items.answer: Yes. Both short-term, phase-based projects and longer monthly engagements.

items.question: Does USelf Labs publish its own products?
items.answer: Yes. Five apps and games are on Google Play: pulso, Puzzena, Velora, Dream Courier and 1000 Lives.

items.question: Is USelf Labs' tooling open source?
items.answer: Partly. The skillsets and behavioral rules for AI coding agents are public on GitHub.

items.question: How does an engagement start?
items.answer: It starts with a conversation to understand the problem, after which USelf Labs proposes a concrete scope and timeline.

items.question: How is client code and data kept secure?
items.answer: Source code belongs to the client. System access is scoped per project, and a confidentiality agreement is signed when needed.

hero.headline: Self-published products
hero.intro: USelf Labs builds and publishes its own apps and games on Google Play. They double as the place techniques get tested on real users, before they reach client work.

apps.name: pulso: Wordless Logic Puzzle
apps.tagline: Fifty handcrafted minimalist logic puzzles with zero words of instruction.
apps.description: Every puzzle is an abstract geometric mechanism discovered through touch, observation, and intuition. Zero timers, zero scores, and zero fail states. 100% offline.
highlights: Fifty handcrafted minimalist logic puzzles with zero words of instruction
Ten core rule modules creating 50 distinct 'Aha!' moments
Zero fail states: no lives, no countdown timers, no scores
Gentle 3-tier visual hint system without text spoilers
100% offline gameplay with no account or internet required

apps.name: Puzzena: Logic Grid Puzzles
apps.tagline: Classic grid-based logic puzzles: Binary, Tents & Trees, Shikaku, and Nonogram.
apps.description: Explore 9,000+ logic puzzles across 4 distinct types: Binary Puzzle (Binairo), Tents & Trees, Shikaku, and Nonogram (Picross). Every puzzle is mathematically pre-verified to have one unique solution solvable strictly through pure deduction. 100% offline with zero guesswork.
highlights: 9,000+ verified logic puzzles across 4 classic types
100% solvable through pure deduction (no guessing)
Binary Puzzle, Tents & Trees, Shikaku, and Nonogram
Fully playable offline with Light, Dark, and Sepia themes
Smart hints, mistake checker, unlimited undo & auto-save

apps.name: Velora: AI Tarot & Horoscope
apps.tagline: AI tarot, horoscope and numerology, personalized to each person's own birth chart.
apps.description: A user enters their birth details once. Every reading after that is generated by AI around their individual chart, instead of one horoscope written for everybody.
highlights: A daily energy forecast drawn from your chart
AI chat about love, career and yourself
Tarot readings with the 78-card Rider-Waite deck
Birth chart and numerology in plain language

apps.name: Dream Courier: Cozy Idle RPG
apps.tagline: A gentle idle RPG about a small courier carrying letters through a world of dreams.
apps.description: Each run plays out on its own, and the player's job is deciding how that run gets built. A Dream Sentence combines three Words, an Action, an Image and a Tone, so 18 Dream Words produce 216 different combinations.
highlights: 18 Dream Words for 216 playstyle combinations
Runs battle automatically, with no tapping needed
3 chapters across 30 stages, 11 enemy types and 3 bosses
16 pieces of equipment to upgrade over time

apps.name: 1000 Lives: Life Simulator
apps.tagline: A life simulator played by swiping: one life's karma follows you into the next.
apps.description: Every choice pulls the player between four forces: Career, Family, Money and Self. One of them hitting zero or maxing out ends that life, and whatever karma is left gets written into the Karma Ledger for the next one.
highlights: Four forces to hold in balance at once
Karma persists and shapes the life that follows
Every ending produces its own tarot card
Each life runs about 2 to 4 minutes

hero.headline: About
hero.intro: USelf Labs is a software lab in Vietnam focused on AI agent systems, software architecture, and developer automation tooling.

story.heading: How USelf Labs came about
story.body: USelf Labs started from one question that kept coming up in day-to-day engineering work: how do you make an AI coding agent genuinely usable inside a real codebase, rather than merely impressive in a demo. Answering it turned into a set of reusable rules and skillsets. In parallel, the self-published apps and games on Google Play do the checking: a principle only counts as usable once it has survived inside a product with real users.

items.title: No invented code
items.body: Every API and library is verified to actually exist before it reaches the codebase.

items.title: Proven by tests
items.body: Test-Driven Development throughout. A feature counts as done when a test proves it.

items.title: Minimal friction
items.body: The simplest solution that solves the problem, with no abstraction layer nobody asked for.

items.title: Modular by default
items.body: Clear boundaries between modules, so changing one part does not drag the rest along.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information USelf Labs collects through uselflabs.com and the apps and games we publish on Google Play, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Who we are and what this covers
paragraphs: USelf Labs ("we", "us") is a software lab based in Vietnam. This policy applies to our website at uselflabs.com and to the apps and games published under the USelf Labs developer account on Google Play.
A product with its own website or its own privacy notice may add details specific to that product. Where they differ, the product-specific notice applies to that product.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect only what we need to run our services:
items: Contact form: your name, email address, company (optional), message, and the language of the page you sent it from.
Technical logs: like most websites, our servers and network provider record IP addresses, browser type, requested pages, and timestamps to keep the site secure and working.
App data: game progress and settings are generally stored on your device. If an app offers cloud saves or accounts, the app tells you what is stored.

Advertising and diagnostics in apps: some apps show ads through Google AdMob and use Google Play services. These may collect device identifiers such as the advertising ID, device and app information, approximate location derived from IP address, and crash or performance data.
Purchases: in-app purchases are processed by Google Play. We receive confirmation of the purchase but never your payment card details.

sections.heading: How we use information
items: To reply to your inquiries and discuss potential projects.
To operate, secure, and improve the website and our apps.
To show ads that keep some apps free, and to measure how those ads perform.
To deliver in-app purchases and restore them on your devices.
To comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service.

sections.heading: Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: The uselflabs.com website does not use advertising or analytics cookies. Our network provider may set strictly necessary cookies to protect the site against abuse.

Inside our apps, advertising SDKs may use the advertising ID or similar identifiers. You can reset or delete your advertising ID and opt out of personalized ads in your device settings (on Android: Settings > Google > Ads, or Settings > Privacy > Ads).

sections.heading: How we share information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only in these cases:
items: Service providers that help us run our services, such as our hosting and network providers, the messaging service that delivers contact form notifications to our team, and Google (AdMob, Google Play). They process data under their own terms and privacy policies.
When required by law, a court order, or to protect the rights, safety, and property of USelf Labs, our users, or others.
As part of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, in which case this policy continues to apply to the information transferred.

sections.heading: Third-party services
paragraphs: Data collected by third-party SDKs is governed by those providers' policies. For Google services, see policies.google.com/privacy and Google's explanation of how it uses information from partner apps at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

sections.heading: How long we keep information
paragraphs: We keep contact inquiries for as long as needed to respond and to follow up on any resulting work, and delete them when they are no longer needed. Technical logs are kept for a limited period for security and troubleshooting. Data stored on your device stays there until you clear the app's data or uninstall it.

sections.heading: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the use of your personal information, and to object to certain processing. To make a request, email us at admin@uselflabs.com. We will respond within a reasonable time and may need to verify your identity first.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
paragraphs: Our services are not directed to children under 13, or the minimum age required in your country. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect information, including encrypted connections (HTTPS). No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: International transfers
paragraphs: We are based in Vietnam, and our service providers may process data in other countries. By using our services, you understand that your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will change the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Significant changes will be highlighted on the website or in the affected apps.

sections.heading: Contact us
paragraphs: Questions about this policy or your information can be sent to admin@uselflabs.com.
